title: How Writing Down Three Thanks a Night Kills a Godly Man's Complaining
caption:
Most guys don't think they complain. They just narrate. The traffic, the boss, the weather, the group chat. Do it long enough and you stop seeing anything God is actually doing in your day.

Here's the fix, and it's small: three lines in a notebook before bed. Specific ones. Not "my family" every night, but the hot coffee, the call back, the meeting you survived. A few weeks in, your mouth starts changing because your eyes did first.

"Do all things without grumbling or disputing." Philippians 2:14

Save this and start tonight.

#faith #godlyman #gratitude #discipline #christianmen
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
